notes.title: New day - new patch!
notes.content: This time, we have fixed the issue with the ladders. Some players were able to keep climbing them even though the ladder was left below 😀

notes.title: Update Notes 19 Aug
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

In this little patch, we've fixed one annoying issue that was accidentally slipped into release.

[list]
[*] When playing in Fullscreen mode the mouse cursor is now hidden.
[/list]

tags.bug: - When playing in Fullscreen mode the mouse cursor is now hidden.

notes.title: Update Notes 18 Aug
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the chandeliers' fall speed on level 6. For some players, they were falling too fast, making several rooms quite challenging to complete.
[/list]
